highlights.description: 从数据构造与所选状态权重匹配的二次存储函数，用于无噪声/有界噪声下的闭环稳定性证明，区别于现有基于输出的IOSS存储函数。
highlights.excerpt: in contrast to existing stability results [20,25], in which the IOSS storage function is defined with respect to the outputs, we construct from data a quadratic storage function matched to the chosen state weight.
highlights.transferability: 可迁移到其他数据驱动输出反馈控制器的稳定性分析设计
highlights.limitation: 依赖无噪声或界噪声假设，尚需扩展到随机噪声/非线性

highlights.description: 通过离线状态样本对数据驱动状态估计进行标定，并给出当缺少状态样本时通过调节状态权重逼近状态反馈MPC的工程做法。
highlights.excerpt: with a few offline state samples, or its state weight can be tuned to achieve state-feedback MPC when no state samples are available.
highlights.transferability: 对实际部署中缺少全状态测量时的权重整定具有参考价值
highlights.limitation: 仅仿真验证，未给出标定误差的定量界

highlights.description: 在无噪声数据下证明闭环轨迹满足约束且数据驱动状态估计指数收敛到原点，界定了方法的有效边界。
highlights.excerpt: For noise-free data, we prove that the closed-loop trajectory satisfies the constraints and the data-driven state estimate converges exponentially to the origin (Theorem 2).
highlights.transferability: 为数据驱动MPC提供理论保证的参考框架
highlights.limitation: 无噪声结论理想化，噪声情形仅界噪声
